description: The identifier type binding of the EEHRxF implementing act (Regulation (EU) 2025/327, Annex X): the HL7 identifier type, extended with NI (national unique identifier) and SS (social security identifier) from the HL7 v2 table 0203, and HI, HIN, REGPID, and REGION.
name: EhdsIdentifierType
title: EHDS identifier type
